summary: Provides a framework for analyzing how SDP attributes behave when several media descriptions share a single transport address, as with BUNDLE. It also categorizes existing SDP attributes according to their multiplexing characteristics. It is a standards-track document.

eli5.summary: When many streams share a single box, some labels still make sense and others clash. This document gives a method for sorting labels into those that can safely share and those that cannot.

questions: which sdp attributes work with multiplexing
how are sdp attributes categorized for bundle
